title: PHNTM One — your AI, on your desk
excerpt: A private AI appliance that talks, remembers, keeps your day, reads your documents and runs your home, on its own hardware. In Private mode (the default), nothing you say leaves the box.
content_html:
Meet PHNTM One, an AI assistant you own. Talk to it, search your documents, keep your day and run your home from the device on your desk. In Private mode, your words stay there.

Reservations open · free today · $549 when orders open · batch 1 ships after 1.0 certification

100% local by defaultZero telemetryNo accountNo subscription, ever

One machine, three promises

Private. Personal. Self-caring.

Everything PHNTM One does comes back to three things. Open any of them and keep going: every claim on this site links to the details.

01 · private

It stays on your desk.

The model, your memories, your documents and your voice are processed on the box. No account, no telemetry, no cloud by default, and a screen that shows you every byte that does leave.

what you say, sent out in Private mode: 0 bytes How privacy works 02 · personal

It gets to know you.

Your people, projects and decisions, your lists and routines, your documents and your home. It recalls by meaning, cites its sources, and forgets when you ask.

memory · documents · lists · home: on the box Everything it does 03 · self-caring

It looks after itself.

Fifteen bounded self-repairs, root cause before symptom, a plain-words weekly report, and never a change to itself without your OK.

checks every 90 s · 15 repairs · you approve upgrades How it looks after itself

See it up close

A small machine with a big presence.

Try a guided simulation of voice, memory, privacy controls and a self-repair scenario without the hardware. Then see the physical device below.

Photos are of the real device and its real interface, retouched with AI for lighting and background. The video is unedited.

Self-care

It takes care of itself.

A supervisor checks the whole device every 90 seconds. When a check confirms a fault, one of fifteen bounded repairs runs, is written down with the reason it was chosen, and, if it touches files, is verified and undone when it didn't work.

Every 90 seconds

Heals what gets stuck

It watches services, the model server, memory, disk, temperature, Wi-Fi and the screen. Fifteen repairs, each with a hard limit: never more than three restarts of one thing in half an hour.

7 of the 15

Fixes that undo themselves

Repairs that touch files or its search indexes run as a transaction: snapshot, fix, verify, then keep it or roll it back. Your own words are never rewritten from an index.

Cause, not symptom

Root cause first

It can tell a cause from a consequence. A repair aimed at a symptom is held back when the evidence points elsewhere, and when it can't tell, it says so.

Learns on your unit

Keeps score, and rehearses

It keeps score of every repair on your unit and prefers what has worked there. On quiet days it breaks something built to be broken and watches the real repair handle it.

Every week

A report in plain words

On the screen and on your phone: what went wrong this week, what it fixed, what it learned, and anything waiting for your OK.

Only with your OK

Improves, when you approve

When a better fix is handed to it, it builds and tests it in a sealed workspace that can't touch your data. It reaches the device only when you approve it and the update is signed, and it rolls back if the self-test fails.

All fifteen repairs, and their limits →

The choice is yours

Three modes. You decide.

Most people never leave Private mode; it's the reason the product exists. For a hard task you can bring your own key, and if you want it to act for you from your phone, there's a mode for that too. Flip the switch to see exactly where your words go in each.

Private: your question goes to the model inside the box and the answer comes back. Nothing crosses the line. Boosted: your question leaves the box for Anthropic, on your own key. The answer comes back labelled, so you always know. Autonomous: you message it from your own Telegram; Claude, on your key, reads the device, your email and calendar, and nothing is sent or changed until you say yes.

Private · default

All local

Free, forever

  • Nothing you say leaves the device.
  • No accounts, no subscriptions, no cloud.
  • A capable on-device model that does honest work with real privacy.
  • Works with the internet unplugged.

Boosted · optional

Frontier model, your key

Your own Anthropic key

  • Dramatically more capable answers when you want them.
  • Runs on your own API credit, so you pay for what you use.
  • Not private: your prompt leaves the box when it answers.
  • Off by default. Local is always the fallback.

Autonomous · optional

It acts for you

Your key + your Telegram

  • Email and calendar, drafted and managed from your phone.
  • Every send or change waits for your yes, and the yes expires in ten minutes.
  • Not private: what you ask goes to Anthropic and through Telegram; confirmed actions reach your email and calendar.
  • Off by default; switching it on needs the device password.

For the skeptics

Check every claim before you buy.

We publish what other companies won't, because you should be able to verify the claims yourself.

Do the math

Stop renting your AI.

A subscription never stops charging. PHNTM One is paid for once. Set what you pay for AI each month and watch three years play out.

Over three years you keep $171 PHNTM One costs less from month 28 on.

$20/ month

This compares cost, not capability. A 4B local model is capable, not a frontier model, and the big cloud models are smarter. You buy PHNTM One for privacy and ownership; the savings are a bonus. Electricity isn't counted. Boosted mode is optional; it uses your own Anthropic key, billed to you per use. Full comparison

Who it's for

Made for people who'd rather own it.

Four kinds of people keep asking for one. Here's how each of them uses it, and where it falls short.

writers

Unpublished work stays home

Dictate drafts, ask your notes, hear them read back. Answers cite the file and page.

 families

No wake word in the house

Kitchen timers, the shopping list, the lights, and no wake word listening in.

 small offices

Documents stay on the premises

Scan receipts and letters, ask the files. One price, no seats, no cloud by default.

 tinkerers

Debian, SSH, readable source

Skills, Home Assistant and SSH. Ready out of the box, yours to open up.

Two choices

One is reserving. Umbra is coming.

Same promise, two shapes: the all-in-one you can reserve today, or a standalone mini PC being built for a much bigger brain.

The vision

PHNTM exists to give people ownership of their intelligence.

We see a future where advanced AI doesn't have to live inside a distant data center, depend on a monthly subscription, or ask you to surrender control of your personal information. Intelligent systems should be able to run locally, learn alongside their owners, protect their privacy, and become more useful over time.

PHNTM is being built as a persistent, autonomous intelligence platform — combining local AI, memory, RAG, perception, automation, self-maintenance, and eventually robotics into one evolving system.

The goal is not to build another chatbot.

The goal is AI that lives on your hardware, understands your world, remembers what matters, takes meaningful action, improves through experience, and stays under your control.

Your hardware. Your data. Your intelligence.

Reservations open · production batch 1

Own your AI.

$549once
no subscription, ever

Every unit is built by hand, burned in for at least 24 hours, and tested. Reserve yours free today: nothing is charged, and batch 1 ships when PHNTM One 1.0 is certified.

  • The device, 10.1″ touchscreen
  • Push-to-talk mic
  • Mini wireless keyboard with touchpad
  • 27 W USB-C power supply
  • 256 GB microSD, everything installed
  • Quick-start card and a serial card

Free US shipping 30-day returns 1-year warranty Nothing charged to reserve

Reserve right here with just your email. Nothing is charged; you get one email when batch 1 opens, and first pick of its units. No spam, and we never sell the list.

Reserved. Nothing is charged.

Or just email me directly with questions, anything.

content_html_zh:
Meet PHNTM One, an AI assistant you own. Talk to it, search your documents, keep your day and run your home from the device on your desk. In Private mode, your words stay there.

Reservations open · free today · $549 when orders open · batch 1 ships after 1.0 certification

100% local by defaultZero telemetryNo accountNo subscription, ever

One machine, three promises

私人的。 Personal. Self-caring.

Everything PHNTM One does comes back to three things. Open any of them and keep going: every claim on this site links to the details.

01 · private

It stays on your desk.

The model, your memories, your documents and your voice are processed on the box. No account, no telemetry, no cloud by default, and a screen that shows you every byte that does leave.

what you say, sent out in Private mode: 0 bytes How privacy works 02 · personal

It gets to know you.

Your people, projects and decisions, your lists and routines, your documents and your home. It recalls by meaning, cites its sources, and forgets when you ask.

memory · documents · lists · home: on the box Everything it does 03 · self-caring

It looks after itself.

Fifteen bounded self-repairs, root cause before symptom, a plain-words weekly report, and never a change to itself without your OK.

checks every 90 s · 15 repairs · you approve upgrades How it looks after itself

See it up close

A small machine with a big presence.

Try a guided simulation of voice, memory, privacy controls and a self-repair scenario without the hardware. Then see the physical device below.

Photos are of the real device and its real interface, retouched with AI for lighting and background. The video is unedited.

Self-care

It takes care of itself.

A supervisor checks the whole device every 90 seconds. When a check confirms a fault, one of fifteen bounded repairs runs, is written down with the reason it was chosen, and, if it touches files, is verified and undone when it didn't work.

Every 90 seconds

Heals what gets stuck

It watches services, the model server, memory, disk, temperature, Wi-Fi and the screen. Fifteen repairs, each with a hard limit: never more than three restarts of one thing in half an hour.

7 of the 15

Fixes that undo themselves

Repairs that touch files or its search indexes run as a transaction: snapshot, fix, verify, then keep it or roll it back. Your own words are never rewritten from an index.

Cause, not symptom

Root cause first

It can tell a cause from a consequence. A repair aimed at a symptom is held back when the evidence points elsewhere, and when it can't tell, it says so.

Learns on your unit

Keeps score, and rehearses

It keeps score of every repair on your unit and prefers what has worked there. On quiet days it breaks something built to be broken and watches the real repair handle it.

Every week

A report in plain words

On the screen and on your phone: what went wrong this week, what it fixed, what it learned, and anything waiting for your OK.

Only with your OK

Improves, when you approve

When a better fix is handed to it, it builds and tests it in a sealed workspace that can't touch your data. It reaches the device only when you approve it and the update is signed, and it rolls back if the self-test fails.

All fifteen repairs, and their limits →

The choice is yours

Three modes. 你决定。

Most people never leave Private mode; it's the reason the product exists. For a hard task you can bring your own key, and if you want it to act for you from your phone, there's a mode for that too. Flip the switch to see exactly where your words go in each.

Private: your question goes to the model inside the box and the answer comes back. Nothing crosses the line. Boosted: your question leaves the box for Anthropic, on your own key. The answer comes back labelled, so you always know. Autonomous: you message it from your own Telegram; Claude, on your key, reads the device, your email and calendar, and nothing is sent or changed until you say yes.

Private · default

All local

Free, forever

  • Nothing you say leaves the device.
  • No accounts, no subscriptions, no cloud.
  • A capable on-device model that does honest work with real privacy.
  • Works with the internet unplugged.

Boosted · optional

Frontier model, your key

Your own Anthropic key

  • Dramatically more capable answers when you want them.
  • Runs on your own API credit, so you pay for what you use.
  • Not private: your prompt leaves the box when it answers.
  • Off by default. Local is always the fallback.

Autonomous · optional

It acts for you

Your key + your Telegram

  • Email and calendar, drafted and managed from your phone.
  • Every send or change waits for your yes, and the yes expires in ten minutes.
  • Not private: what you ask goes to Anthropic and through Telegram; confirmed actions reach your email and calendar.
  • Off by default; switching it on needs the device password.

For the skeptics

Check every claim before you buy.

We publish what other companies won't, because you should be able to verify the claims yourself.

做数学题

Stop renting your AI.

A subscription never stops charging. PHNTM One is paid for once. Set what you pay for AI each month and watch three years play out.

Over three years you keep $171 PHNTM One costs less from month 28 on.

Your monthly AI subscription

$20/ month

This compares cost, not capability. A 4B local model is capable, not a frontier model, and the big cloud models are smarter. You buy PHNTM One for privacy and ownership; the savings are a bonus. Electricity isn't counted. Boosted mode is optional; it uses your own Anthropic key, billed to you per use. Full comparison

这是给谁的

Made for people who'd rather own it.

Four kinds of people keep asking for one. Here's how each of them uses it, and where it falls short.

writers

Unpublished work stays home

Dictate drafts, ask your notes, hear them read back. Answers cite the file and page.

 families

No wake word in the house

Kitchen timers, the shopping list, the lights, and no wake word listening in.

 small offices

Documents stay on the premises

Scan receipts and letters, ask the files. One price, no seats, no cloud by default.

 tinkerers

Debian, SSH, readable source

Skills, Home Assistant and SSH. Ready out of the box, yours to open up.

Two choices

One is reserving. Umbra is coming.

Same promise, two shapes: the all-in-one you can reserve today, or a standalone mini PC being built for a much bigger brain.

The vision

PHNTM exists to give people ownership of their intelligence.

We see a future where advanced AI doesn't have to live inside a distant data center, depend on a monthly subscription, or ask you to surrender control of your personal information. Intelligent systems should be able to run locally, learn alongside their owners, protect their privacy, and become more useful over time.

PHNTM is being built as a persistent, autonomous intelligence platform — combining local AI, memory, RAG, perception, automation, self-maintenance, and eventually robotics into one evolving system.

The goal is not to build another chatbot.

The goal is AI that lives on your hardware, understands your world, remembers what matters, takes meaningful action, improves through experience, and stays under your control.

Your hardware. 你的数据。 Your intelligence.
